testedSource: manifest of modified worktree based on base commit; packaged source commit will be identified by separate package attestation

retainedFailures.historical: No attribution of FPM zero-tick, SQL handler disconnect, or slow-input TLS failure to this fix.

limits: This is accept-error isolation, not entity-wide completion or deployment certification.
Existing server HTTP/2, HTTP/3, WebSocket upgrade and universal performance targets are not implemented/certified by this change.
